content: {"hypothesis": "The low-severity cmd.exe alert most likely reflects benign activity: tpautoconnsvc.exe (ThinPrint AutoConnect, used in VMware/RDP printer redirection) is writing printer PPD files, which is normal print-driver behavior, so querying the unrelated repwmiutils.exe process is a cheap way to check for a suspicious parent of cmd.exe.", "attack_likelihood": 0.1, "choice": 6}
